access_token = simple_note_token

from math import ceil

def fetch_all_notes(query):
    page_index=0
    all_items=[]
    while True:
        res = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        print('query',query,'page',page_index,'count',len(res))
        if not res:
            break
        all_items.extend(res)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    return all_items

# Parse note 3084 to get shares
import re
note_text = res_notes[3084]['content']
shares=[]
for line in note_text.splitlines():
    m=re.match(r"-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*\$?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", line.strip())
    if m:
        name=m.group(1).strip()
        amt=float(m.group(2))
        shares.append((name,amt))
print('shares_parsed',shares)
